name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-02-09, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.13 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
